messages:
maria (support): FYI - multiple customers reporting hourly usage missing in Console since ~08:00 UTC (~4h). Example tenant: tenant_93. Dashboard shows gaps in hourly rollups. Can infra/data take a look? https://console.prod.redwood/usage/tenant_93 (screenshot attached)

olivia (infra-oncall): Thanks — can you paste a quick example query + time range that shows the gap? Also which backend env (prod-us)?

maria (support): Prod-us. Example: run against analytics.hourly_rollups for tenant_93 between 2026-03-17 04:00 and 2026-03-17 12:00.

SQL snippet:

```
SELECT ts_hour, count_tokens, events_processed
FROM analytics.hourly_rollups
WHERE tenant_id = 'tenant_93'
  AND ts_hour >= '2026-03-17 04:00'
  AND ts_hour < '2026-03-17 12:00'
ORDER BY ts_hour;
```

We get rows until 08:00, then a gap until 12:00 (now).

kevin (data-eng): I pulled the same tenant. Looks like consumer lag on the usage-cdc consumer started spiking around 07:40 UTC. Offsets show a big backlog for partition ranges belonging to tenant shards 90-95. Paste consumer status:

```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group usage-cdc
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
usage.events    12         1412345         1419876         7531
usage.events    13         876543          885000          8457
```

kevin (data-eng): Also noticed a long-running backfill job kicked at 06:50 by ops-backfill-scheduler that started touching hourly_rollups with a full-table COPY/upsert pattern. It held an exclusive-ish lock during merge steps causing downstream CDC processors to stall when they tried to write, which explains missing hourly rows.

deploy-bot: [notice] ops-backfill-scheduler started backfill job backfill-hourly-2026-03-17 at 06:50 UTC (job_id: bf-20260317-42)

sam (sre): If the backfill is holding locks that's bad for CDC consumers. Kevin — can you confirm if it's a table-level lock or row-level? If it's COPY then we may need to pause the backfill.

kevin (data-eng): It's doing batched upserts but the merge uses a temp table + rename which briefly takes a table-level exclusive lock for the rename/atomic swap. That coincides with the consumer spikes. I can reproduce with a small script locally.

olivia (infra-oncall): Plan: 1) Pause the backfill job immediately to let CDC drain. 2) Restart CDC consumer group (usage-cdc) to resume processing. 3) Run targeted idempotent backfill per-tenant range with lower lock footprint. Who can pause the backfill? @kevin?

kevin (data-eng): I can pause / stop the scheduled job. Pausing now.

kevin (data-eng): paused job bf-20260317-42 — deploy scheduler acknowledged. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

sam (sre): I'll trigger a consumer group rebalance after a short wait, give writes ~60s to settle.

sam (sre): Running: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --group usage-cdc --reset-offsets --to-latest --execute --all-topics` (will monitor)

sam (sre): Consumer offsets progressed, lag dropping. Current lag for critical partitions down < 200.

maria (support): Customer-facing note: "We're investigating delayed hourly metrics and have restarted processing. Expected catch-up within 1 hour. Will update if anything changes." — should I send that now?

olivia (infra-oncall): Yes please send that to impacted customers, and add we'll run a safe targeted backfill for the 07:00-12:00 window.

maria (support): Sent update to a handful of impacted accounts. (reaction :envelope_with_arrow:)

kevin (data-eng): Next steps for data team: implement tenant-scoped backfill tool that writes with idempotent upserts (no table-swap), and run for tenants 90-95 during low traffic window (02:00-04:00 UTC). I'll open a PR with the change and schedule the job.

kevin (data-eng): For immediate remediation I'll run a targeted backfill for 2026-03-17 07:00-12:00 for tenant_93 only and throttle concurrency to 2 workers. Starting now.

kevin (data-eng): targeted backfill job started (job_id: bf-target-93-20260317). Using upsert loop, batch_size=1k, sleep_ms=200 between batches.

sam (sre): Monitoring table locks and CDC. No new long locks appearing. Kafka lag now almost zero.

kevin (data-eng): Targeted backfill completed for tenant_93. Verified rows inserted for missing hours.

maria (support): Verified in Console for tenant_93 — hourly rows now appear for 07:00-11:00. Customer updated. Thanks team.

olivia (infra-oncall): Follow-ups: - Kevin to merge idempotent backfill PR + run cross-tenant pass during low window. - Sam to add a check to alert if any scheduled backfill job holds table-swap locks for >30s. - Maria to send final summary to impacted customers when global pass completes.

kevin (data-eng): A note for postmortem: backfill used atomic rename pattern that is fine for maintenance windows but unsafe while CDC is live. We'll add a safety flag to scheduler to require maintenance window or use idempotent mode by default.

maria (support): Closing customer loop now. Will watch for any reoccurrence and reopen if we see more customer reports. (reaction :lock_with_ink_pen:)
